description: This file defines an asynchronous chatbot implementation using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model services, and custom functions for flight status and taxi booking, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

methods.name: check_flight_status
methods.description: Asynchronous function to check flight status and departure time, calls result_callback with status info.

methods.name: book_taxi
methods.description: Asynchronous function to book a taxi at a specified time, calls result_callback with status.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to initialize services, set up pipeline, and handle client connection events for the bot.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and runs the bot pipeline.
